name: Melanotan I
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: Melanotan I (MT1) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is Melanotan I tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each MT1 lot is run on RP-HPLC against a ≥99.0% (HPLC) release limit, then confirmed by MS. The batch certificate carries the measured purity, retention time and mass together with the identity string (CAS 75921-69-6, formula C78H111N21O19, 1646.8 Da).

faq.question: How should Melanotan I be stored?
faq.answer: Melanotan I ships lyophilized and should stay at −20 °C until reconstitution; after that keep it at 2–8 °C and avoid freeze–thaw cycles.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Melanotan I?
faq.answer: Melanotan I is stocked in 1 pack size (10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $54.32; 10–49 kits falls to $49.98 (−8%) and 50+ to $46.18 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
